entities.summary: Anna Mikhaylovna Yevreinova, also referred to as Johanna von Evreinov, was a Russian feminist writer, lawyer and literary editor. Following her study at the University of Leipzig, she was the first Russian woman to earn the Doctor of Law degree, she was also the first woman who obtained the Doctor of Law degree from a German university.
